# POURnogravy

> Mildly offensive bartender apparel for service industry survivors.
> Made by a dark-humored, sarcastic bartender. For dark-humored, sarcastic bartenders.

## What We Sell

POURnogravy makes print-on-demand t-shirts with bartender humor and industry-specific
references. Every design is written from the perspective of an exhausted, over-it
bartender who has seen too much but somehow still shows up for their shift.

Shirts are $27.99 USD. Unisex fit. Ships from the US. Free shipping on orders over $75.

## Current Products

- **Last Call for Karen** — Skull graphic with roses. For bartenders who have dealt
  with one too many difficult customers. `/product/last-call-for-karen-tee`
- **I Would Totally Tap That** — Keg graphic. Double meaning, fully intentional.
  `/product/i-would-totally-tap-that-keg-tee`
- **POURnogravy OG Tee** — The brand logo. The official uniform for bartender legends.
  `/product/pournogravy-og-tee-the-official-uniform-for-bartender-legends`
- **Service Bartender, Do Not Approach** — Dog graphic. For the bartender who needs
  personal space. `/product/service-bartender-do-not-approach-tee`
- **The Finger** — Direct. Unambiguous. `/product/the-finger-tee`
- **Well, It Ain't Gonna Lick Itself** — Margarita graphic. Bar humor at its finest.
  `/product/well-it-ain-t-gonna-lick-itself-tee`

## About the Brand

POURnogravy was created by Opie, a bartender who got tired of dealing with the
socially stupid and decided to wear his feelings on his chest — literally.
The brand targets bartenders, servers, hospitality workers, and anyone who has
ever had to smile through a ridiculous customer interaction.
